name: telos-toolkit
description: Bundles the Project Telos flagship MCP servers (crucible, gather, index, forum, learn) plus a workspace-navigation skill and slash commands so an agent knows where everything lives and how to verify it.

learn_mcp_path.title: learn MCP server path (src/mcp.mjs)
learn_mcp_path.description: Absolute path to the learn package's src/mcp.mjs. The @harperz9/learn npm package ships this file but exposes only the `learn` CLI bin, so the MCP stdio server must be launched by file path. Find it after install with: npm root -g then look under @harperz9/learn/src/mcp.mjs. Leave blank to disable the learn MCP server; the other four still load.
